modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

KU10. recommended process for cleaning machine

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done and work requirements by interpreting instructions received from the supervisor

identify and select suitable 3D printing machine as per specified machine specifications (i.e. build speed, extrusion speed, nozzle temperature) and raw material to print the automotive components as per product specifications
check material and machine for any issues and required quality standards before use
determine the part orientation and support structure requirement from Computer Aided Design (CAD) data
set the 3D printing machine and its parameters such as room temperature range, air cleanliness as per SOP/WI
clean the 3D printing machine by following organisational recommended process before starting the operation

modules.module_title: Select and upload code files into system memory

pcs.pc_description: select the standard tesselation language (.stl) code file needed for machine operation
connect the data storage devices with the machine
coordinate with designer to rectify any errors which are generated during the file uploading process or errors observed during the running of the process
pre-heat the bed of the machine to adequate temperature as per process specifications
set the laser or nozzles temperature to defined values as per process specification
start and operate the machine and perform 3D printing operations as per SOP/WI
use the emergency stop button in case of any unfavorable situation
rectify any process errors if any during the machine operation and report the same to the concerned person as per organizational guidelines
remove the printed part from machine without damaging its structure
identify & carefully remove the support structures present in the fabricated part
clean the part for improving the surface finish as per SOP
clean and store the tools, equipment and auxiliaries after completion of work as per the guidelines
inspect the part as per the drawing/process using for required quality and if non-conforming, take action as per organisational guidelines
store & preserve the automotive parts manufactured as per organizational guidelines and procedures

modules.module_title: Carry out maintenance of 3D Printing Machine

pcs.pc_description: perform daily check of machine's critical parts as per maintenance checklist or manufacturer guidelines
carry out minor repairs, adjustments and alignment of loose bolts, belts, drive slacks, guards and covers
carry out troubleshooting of machine for issues and defects identification
perform lubrication of machine by using appropriate lubricant
place tags on machines for next maintenance cycles
maintain records of maintenance activities done on machine as per organizational procedures
